summary: Camden County towersite of 80 acres acquired FY 1948-49, with a steel tower erected in 1952. No source found describes the site now.

facts.status_note: No source we found says whether the tower still stands.

events.note: FY 1948-49: an 80-acre towersite was acquired, per the commission's annual report.

evidence.supports: Site is in Camden County, filed under the Missouri Conservation Commission
